handoff: Review #4: approve. Review #3's F1 (status and story list refuse config errors with exit 6) and F2 (migrate offers a team notifiers list as notify:) are fixed, and so are its minors. Checked with the dev build in temp repos. The whole spec (B1–B55) was checked against the whole diff: nothing missing, nothing out of scope, tests at the agreed seams. Unit 1079/0, typecheck clean. Minor, not blocking: init on a self-hosted remote refuses before writing anything, and the hint should name 'norn config set provider … --repo' (B54); the moved-key replacement text is per key, not per file (B39: team default_mode/default_agent); the B54 error is prefixed with a file that may not exist; SPEC-herdr-cockpit.md and LIMITATIONS.md still name removed keys; a config set modeline can point at a missing schema copy; workflowLevelKeysOnSteps hand-rolls a shape check; the void ctx.config getter idiom. Plus nits.

findings.title: init on a self-hosted remote refuses before writing anything
findings.detail:
Since 77733c5b3 (`void ctx.config` up front), `norn init` in a repo with remote git@git.acme.internal:app.git exits 6 and writes nothing. The message says to set `provider` in .agents/norn.config.yaml, a file that does not exist yet, and do_instead says `fix .agents/norn.config.yaml`. You can recover with `norn config set provider glab --repo` followed by `norn init` (verified), but the hint does not say so.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Let B54's do_instead name `norn config set provider <gh|glab> --repo`, or check only file problems (not derived ones) before init writes anything.

findings.title: Moved-key replacement is per key, not per file
findings.detail:
In the team file, `default_mode` says its replacement is `mode`, but the team file refuses `mode` as wrong file (the real replacement is each workflow's mode, B42). `default_agent` in the team file names `agent`, which is a personal key.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Make the replacement text depend on the file for these keys.

findings.title: B54 error is prefixed with the team file even when it does not exist
findings.detail:
It starts with `.agents/norn.config.yaml`: even when that file is absent. The spec example starts with `can't tell the provider from …`.
Axis: spec

findings.title: Two docs still name removed keys
findings.detail:
.agents/SPEC-herdr-cockpit.md:83 tells you to opt in with `notifiers: [{adapter: os}, {adapter: herdr}]` (also against B20). .agents/LIMITATIONS.md:44 names `limits.attended_wait` (against B27). Neither file is on B52's list or covered by the S5 lint.
Axis: spec

findings.title: Modeline can point at a missing schema copy
findings.detail:
A file created by `config set` gets `$schema=<basename>`, but only init and migrate write the schema copies, so in a repo or home without them the modeline points at nothing.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Call writeConfigSchemas when config set creates a file.

findings.title: workflowLevelKeysOnSteps hand-rolls a shape check
findings.detail:
It runs before validated('workflow') and returns its own error shape, against AGENTS.md's 'never hand-roll checks of these shapes'.
Axis: standards

findings.title: `void ctx.config` reads a getter for its throw
findings.detail:
The same pattern is at init.ts:146, human.ts:54 and store config.ts:63. A named `ctx.requireConfig()` would show the intent and could not be deleted as an unused line.
Axis: standards

findings.title: SCHEMA_COPY orphans writeConfigSchemas' doc block
findings.detail:
SCHEMA_COPY and its JSDoc sit between writeConfigSchemas and its doc block, so that doc now attaches to the wrong declaration.
Axis: standards

findings.title: do_instead quotes with JSON.stringify
findings.detail:
Inside double quotes the shell still expands $, backticks and !. Use single quotes. The same file also has duplication nits: inRightFile repeats schema's rightFile, asRecord repeats isMap, and the { set } | { unset } type is spelled out three times.
Axis: standards

findings.title: Stale text and possibly dead code
findings.detail:
done.ts:198 still says 'unverified per capability'. The test name at decide.test.ts:307 still says 'capped by max_checks'. The 'auto requested, no runner' downgrade (policy.ts:19, brief.ts:202) looks unreachable after B12, unless it is kept for replaying old ticks. Migrate adds a blank line after a leading comment in the user file. Migrate's notifier advice prints 'undefined' for list entries without `adapter` (invalid old input only).
Axis: spec
